instruction: Extend app/electron/preload.js without changing the existing window.api contract. Keep runUpload, stopUpload, getVideoList, getUploadStatus, streamLog, and onLog behaving exactly as they do now, including onLog subscribing to app:log and returning an unsubscribe function. Add only safe ipcRenderer.invoke-based settings methods on the same window.api object, such as loadWorkflowSettings and saveWorkflowSettings, so the renderer can read and persist workflow settings without exposing Node APIs.
